ablation: Arm A: L1 top-down path (lesion_l1) — the same lesion as K3/K3B/K3C/K3D. Intact and lesioned arms share identical agent init seeds and identical episode seeds within each primary seed (paired); trajectories diverge by design (closed-loop). Arm B: prediction-only planning lesion (plan_global_map) — the trained intact model's R_ctx per-branch reward tables are zeroed in the selector's vhat query only; weights, memory, beliefs, and learning machinery identical across the two planners.
background: EXP-AB-K3D (2026-10-07, 4 fresh seeds {76101..76104}, preregistered) characterized the hierarchy's surviving |e0| channel: on delayed_reward the L1-lesion gap is D_e0=+0.0986 seed-mean, 4/4 positive, 95pct t-CI [+0.0033,+0.1939] (excludes 0) — the strongest hierarchy signal in the program. The gap lives in the branch channel (+0.0504 seed-mean, 4/4 positive): the 3 L1 contexts (one per branch value {0,1,2}) memorize per-branch constants that L0's global map compromises on. Everywhere else the |e0| channel is thin (changing_rule stable +0.0070/post-flip +0.0103, CIs include 0) or dead/negative (delayed_multistep -0.0555, compositional_rule post-flip -0.0168). Open question: is this per-branch prediction advantage LOAD-BEARING for control, or prediction-only decoration? This experiment answers it with two preregistered arms.
baseline: Arm A: arch_b lesion_l1=True (L0-only), closed-loop, paired seeds. Arm B: the same frozen trained intact model with plan_global_map=True (L0-only reward predictions in the selector query).

conditions.N_episodes: 30 per arm per seed (both arms). ~330-450 online ticks per arm — comparable training volume to K3D's 600-transition open-loop stream where the |e0| gap was detected (same etas).
conditions.agent_init_seeds: 77120+si, paired across arms within each primary seed.
conditions.arm_A: Closed-loop lesion (total causal effect). Intact (lesion_l1=False) vs lesioned (lesion_l1=True) ArchB, action_mode='active_inference', affect='none', learning ON (online). Canonical runner experiments.run_closed_loop verbatim. Episode seeds derive_seed(s, ep, 'env') — identical across arms.
conditions.arm_B: Mechanistic planner (isolate planning from learning). Per primary seed: ONE intact ArchB trained open-loop on the K3D-faithful delayed_reward stream (60 episodes via ArchB closed-loop reference affect='none', ref seed base 77210+si; train first 600 transitions via experiments_k3d._train_agent verbatim, agent init 77120+si). Two frozen (frozen=True, etas preserved at 0 through restore) closed-loop controllers from the same trained snapshot (model weights + precision state + episodic memory restored identically): P = per-branch planner (default vhat = full predict_reward incl. R_ctx); G = global-map planner (plan_global_map=True: vhat = predict_reward_global, R_ctx zeroed in the selector query only). Same episode seeds, action_mode='active_inference', affect='none'.
conditions.env: delayed_reward v1.0.0 only — the env where the branch-channel signal lives.
conditions.episode_seeds: derive_seed(s, ep, 'env') per canonical runner; agent per-episode reset derive_seed(episode_seed, run_index, 'agent').
conditions.instrument: Arm A: experiments.run_closed_loop (canonical, verbatim). Arm B training: experiments_k3d._train_agent + collect_transitions (K3D-verbatim); planning knob: additive ArchB plan_global_map + HierarchicalGenerativeModel.predict_reward_global (new code, tripwire-scanned pre-run).

consciousness_note: CONSCIOUSNESS: UNRESOLVED. Prediction-error gaps and control gaps are mechanisms, not subjects. No claim about experience is made or implied by any outcome.
decision_rule: Carrying metric (both arms): per-seed mean episode return gap G = mean(R_condition) - mean(R_control); seed-mean over the 4 fresh seeds. LOAD-BEARING fires iff seed-mean G > +0.05 AND G > 0 on >= 3/4 seeds. Verdict mapping: (i) Arm A fires -> the branch-channel |e0| advantage is LOAD-BEARING for closed-loop control (MATURITY hierarchy row extended; upgrade evaluated). (ii) Arm A null but Arm B fires -> PARTIAL: the per-branch reward machinery is usable for control but the online lesion compensates (learning confound); the |e0| channel itself remains prediction-only decoration. (iii) Both null -> PREDICTION-ONLY DECORATION: the hierarchy's strongest signal does not convert into control; recorded as the bound (research/negative_results.md NR-B-011) with the mechanism note below. No other outcome reinterprets the gates.
donor_provenance: No donor code. ArchB, the env, and the new planning knob are Estate-native (flesh-pits prototypes/experiments).

gates_void.G0a: fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on new/modified code, pre-run.
gates_void.G0b: determinism spot-check: seed 77101 arm-A intact recomputed through the identical helper; per-episode returns identical to 1e-12, else VOID the run.
gates_void.G0c: hash-chained receipts (arch-b detail + lane summary) + verify_chain on the lane receipts dir.
gates_void.G0d: crash/non-finite -> VOID that seed (no reseeding). If a seed voids, the >=3/4 rule is evaluated on remaining seeds with the +0.05 seed-mean bar unchanged, reported transparently.

hypothesis: The delayed_reward branch-channel |e0| advantage (K3D: D_e0 +0.0986, branch channel +0.0504, 4/4) translates into closed-loop control advantage: (Arm A) intact ArchB earns higher mean episode return than L1-lesioned ArchB on delayed_reward; (Arm B, sharper) a frozen controller planning with per-branch reward predictions (R_ctx) beats the same controller planning with the L0 global map.
mechanism_note_preregistered: Why the null is the honest prior: (1) the branch obs channel echoes the agent's own t=0 choice — better prediction of it cannot improve action ranking; (2) verified in agent.py _select_action: ArchB's selector NEVER queries predict_next — action selection uses only vhat=predict_reward and ehat=memory/selector error tables, so the |e0| channel is disconnected from control by architecture; (3) the only per-branch path into the selector is R_ctx, and R_ctx per-branch tables converge to identical values across branches because P(correct|branch)=0.5 (correct branch hidden) — K3B preregistered terminal |rerr| gap ~= 0 for the same reason; (4) throwaway pilot (seed 99903, instrument calibration only, thresholds not informed): both arms dither at mean_return ~0.04 (max 0.18 shaping-only, terminal +1.0 never reached), gap +0.0013, determinism PASS. The experiment's value is the bound either way.
metric: Per primary seed: G_A = mean_return(intact) - mean_return(lesioned) over 30 closed-loop episodes (Arm A); G_B = mean_return(P) - mean_return(G) over 30 closed-loop episodes (Arm B). Carrying: seed-mean G over {77101,77102,77103,77104}. Gate: seed-mean > +0.05 AND positive on >= 3/4 seeds. Secondary diagnostics (descriptive, not gated): per-seed returns; last-15-episode gaps; n_contexts and ||D_ctx|| per context at end of Arm A runs (was the L1 machinery engaged?); trained-model R_ctx values per context in Arm B (do per-branch reward tables differ?).
null: G_A and G_B are ~0: the branch-channel |e0| advantage does not convert into closed-loop control advantage — prediction-only decoration. Recorded as the bound (NR-B-011).
pilot_notes: Throwaway pilot on seed 99903 (zero overlap with any lab seed; numbers never interpreted for any claim): arm-A instrument runs clean — intact mean_return +0.0393, lesioned +0.0380 (gap +0.0013), 2x30 episodes in 2.8s, determinism PASS. Behavior: both arms dither (branch_a/branch_b no-ops after t=0, occasional forward/stay); max return +0.18 (shaping only); the terminal +1.0 is never reached by either arm in 30 episodes. No thresholds were informed by the pilot (gate +0.05/3-of-4 comes from the task directive).
procedure: BEFORE RUN: write this preregistration; implement the additive planning knob; tripwire scan (G0a). RUN: for each primary seed s in {77101,77102,77103,77104} (si = 0..3): Arm A — intact and lesioned ArchB (init seed 77120+si) via run_closed_loop 30 episodes; Arm B — ref stream (60 eps, ref init 77210+si), train intact open-loop on first 600 transitions (init 77120+si), build two frozen controllers restoring trained model+memory (etas kept at 0), run 30 episodes each with P/G planning queries. G0b determinism spot-check on seed 77101 arm-A intact. AFTER: hash-chained detail + lane receipts, verify_chain, registry/MATURITY/negative-results updates, gate suite green.
task: Make the delayed_reward branch-channel hierarchy effect LOAD-BEARING (or kill it trying): closed-loop control test + mechanistic planner arm.
title: EXP-AB-K3E preregistration — is the branch-channel |e0| advantage load-bearing for closed-loop control?
